title: Cover checkout changes during a retired note in a combined acceptance request
outcome: Exercise retiredCheckDispositions and rejectedCheckDisposition in one request. The production source and registration checks run after earlier retired notes, but existing regressions cover isolated rejected requests.
acceptance: A deterministic combined-request behavior test advances HEAD during the earlier retired note, gets committed_input_changed, and sees only the retired note and no evaluator. Cover a newly registered matching run during that same boundary with the corresponding refusal.
